title: Sonu Nigam Buys Rs 44.30 Crore Apartment in Mumbai's Andheri West
excerpt: The 3,055 sq ft apartment in Vartamaan on Juhu Versova Link Road includes four parking spaces; the deal was registered on October 30 with Rs 2.65 crore in stamp duty, registration documents show.
body:
• Singer Sonu Nigam has bought a 3,055 sq ft carpet-area apartment in Andheri West, Mumbai, for Rs 44.30 crore, according to property registration documents accessed by Liases Foras and reported by Hindustan Times.
  • The apartment is on the upper floor of Vartamaan, formerly known as Mannat, on Juhu Versova Link Road, and the deal includes four car parking spaces.
  • The transaction was registered on October 30, 2026, through a deed of apartment. Stamp duty was Rs 2.65 crore.
  • The seller named in the documents is Monish Mangalkumar Darda, acting through his power-of-attorney holder Kalpana Monish Darda. Neither buyer nor seller could be reached for comment in the HT report.

Singer Sonu Nigam has bought a residential apartment in Mumbai's Andheri West for Rs 44.30 crore - Rs 443 million - according to property registration documents accessed by Liases Foras. The Hindustan Times report, reproduced in full by BestDealss, puts the carpet area at 3,055 sq ft, or 283.82 sq metres. At the recorded agreement value, that works out to about Rs 1.45 lakh per sq ft of carpet area.

The property, as the documents describe it

The apartment is on the upper floor of a building named Vartamaan, previously known as Mannat, on Juhu Versova Link Road in Andheri (West), according to the registration documents. The deal includes four car parking spaces, each measuring roughly 10 sq metres in the documents. The property falls under the Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation, and the registration details record the land at about 1,516 sq metres.

Those are the details the documents support. The reports do not describe the apartment's interiors, layout beyond its carpet area, or amenities, and this article does not add any.

Price, stamp duty and registration

The agreement value was recorded at Rs 44.30 crore (Rs 44,30,00,000) and stamp duty at Rs 2.65 crore (Rs 2,65,80,000), according to the documents. The transaction was registered on October 30, 2026, through a deed of apartment. A second, shorter report by Cineflix Media, also citing Hindustan Times, confirms the same three core facts: 3,055 sq ft, Versova side of Andheri, Rs 44.30 crore, completed on October 30.

His recent Mumbai property deals

The same HT report places this purchase in a run of Mumbai transactions over the past two years. In deals registered on August 6, 2026, Nigam bought three commercial units in the Aston building in Sundervan Complex on Lokhandwala Road, Andheri West, for a combined Rs 17 crore, according to registration documents accessed by CRE Matrix. The report also lists land purchases in Karjat in April and May 2026 and, in 2025, the leasing of a 4,257 sq ft commercial property in the Trade Centre BKC building in Santacruz East to Pattni Hospitality for more than Rs 12.61 crore over five years, in documents reviewed by SquareYards.

For diaspora readers who follow celebrity homes, the disciplined takeaway is the registered record itself: a named building, a measured carpet area, four parking spaces, a dated registration and a stated stamp duty. Anything beyond that - how the singer will use the apartment, or what it looks like inside - is not in the sources and has not been reported here.
